MathJax 3.2.2 (https://www.mathjax.org), Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE.txt).

From the "mathjax" npm package (version 3.2.2): es5/tex-mml-chtml.js and its fonts (es5/output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2),
in the same relative folders, as MathJax loads its fonts relative to the script.
Used by the MathJax text plugin (Roadkill.Plugins/Text/BuiltIn/MathJax.cs), served by Roadkill instead of a CDN.
